think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numerical knob with an inherent ordering. 3) If numerical, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just changing magnitude. 4) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as not special.
